items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Well, number one, Peter Boccage was a good violin player.

ctx.x: I just wondered, what about in those string bands? Who were some of the fiddle players?
Well, number one, Peter Boccage was a good violin player.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: No, no, I worked with Pete for a long time.

ctx.x: Now, the other day you were playing with Peter Bocard there. Is that the first time you worked with Peter?

No, no, I worked with Pete for a long time. He played, I played practically, just like I said, Pete would play from different bands, with one band from another, see, but he played, he played most of that with that tuxedo band, you know, and the Eureka, he played with all them bands, different bands, and now, because he just, he just made this band up, this band, what he's got now, he called it the Creole Serenators. Oh yeah, that's the late years. Yeah, that's the late years, the Creole Serenators, you see, and…
Was the violin always the leader of the band?
